selection.name: ai-memory (C02)
selection.role: Alternative sole memory owner; strongest documented operational fit for scoped decisions and explicit handoffs.
selection.install_source: Upstream installation cookbook documents the GitHub release backend and version pinning; v2.5.2 was reviewed.

basis.shows: Released Claude Code/Codex hooks and MCP integration, scoped capture, inspectable Markdown and explicit cross-agent handoffs; optional LLM processing.

Scoped purge, consistent SQLite backup with wiki/config, stopped-server restore and checkpoint page recovery. Complete recovery requires the database backup; purge retains Git history and earlier backups.
Documented Linux installation and native-client wiring.
Explicit WSL2 support, Linux x86_64 installation and macOS arm64 release binaries. Its default operation requires no GPU.

Upstream September 21 evaluation reports LongMemEval-S hit@5 of 0.815 with local embeddings and 0.666 with FTS, using 470 scored questions. These are retrieval measurements, not a matched comparison against the other candidates.
Workspace tests, source-install checks and Docker packaging smoke tests; macOS coverage is conditional.
GitHub API reports SUCCESS for the Ubuntu test job at the inspected default-branch commit.
Unarchived; 15 open issues in the inspected snapshot. Recently updated issues demonstrate ongoing activity, without establishing a responsiveness rate.
Release published October 1, 2026, including Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 assets.
Latest inspected default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026.

selection.name: Hindsight (C05)
selection.role: Alternative sole memory owner; substantial published memory evaluation and documented automated capture and recovery.
selection.install_command:
npx @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents install claude-code --server daemon
npx @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents install codex --server daemon
selection.install_source: Current unified coding-agents installation guide at commit 0be6c02b2aafc2b6bdb188ef1842ac507e0cfa2b; core release v0.10.2 reviewed.

basis.shows: Shared Claude/Codex repository banks, automatic conversation/git ingestion, curated knowledge pages, capture controls and diagnostics. Explicit daemon mode avoids the default Cloud deployment; extraction requires a configured model provider.
Cross-instance bank export/import carries documents, facts, observations, attachments and knowledge pages. Audit history is optional; fact/entity identifiers change on transfer.
Inspectable memory provenance, editing, invalidation and restoration. Complete hard-deletion propagation through generated prose remains unverified.

The primary paper's search-indexed abstract reports 83.6% accuracy with a 20B model versus 39% for its same-backbone full-context baseline. This does not establish superiority over the shortlisted native-client installations.
Upstream API and client-integration test suites. The inspected recent commit checks did not establish a passing full test run.
Documented Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 support, self-hosting and local model providers. The coding-agent daemon guide additionally requires a current Rust toolchain on macOS.
Unarchived with ongoing issue activity; sampled capture-related reports remain reports rather than verified defects.
Release published September 29, 2026.
Latest inspected default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026.

selection.name: agentmemory (rohitg00) (C08)
selection.role: Alternative sole memory owner; broad native-client capture, handoff, inspection and lifecycle tooling.
selection.install_source: Upstream release README documents the npx setup and native-client selection; keep its iii-engine v0.11.2 dependency separate from newer default-branch instructions.

basis.shows: Claude/Codex integration, scoped memory, handoff/lesson tooling, inspection UI, audited deletion, Git snapshots and export/import. WSL2 is documented as the preferred Windows path; exact macOS arm64 installation remains unverified.
Upstream reports LongMemEval-S R@5 of 95.2%, R@10 of 98.6% and MRR of 88.2%; the page expressly disclaims a measured head-to-head against the other listed projects.
A separate 15-question coding evaluation explicitly limits headline interpretation.
Build, skills checks and npm tests across Ubuntu/macOS and multiple Node versions.
Inspected GitHub check records report SUCCESS for Ubuntu and macOS test jobs at the reviewed default-branch commit.
Unarchived with active issues; the sampled recently updated issues were closed. This sample does not establish overall responsiveness.
Release published August 16, 2026, within 90 days.
Latest inspected default-branch commit dated October 1, 2026.

layers.deciding_comparison: The three selections are mutually exclusive sole-owner alternatives; evidence does not establish one overall winner. All 17 repositories were unarchived and had default-branch commits within 90 days at the October 1 EDT audit. On WSL2 x86_64, run version-pinned ai-memory, Hindsight and agentmemory separately over identical source-grounded decisions, conflicting project scopes, Claude-to-Codex handoffs, abstention cases, interrupted capture and compaction. Measure useful-write quality, capture loss, recall correctness, provenance, scope leakage, deletion surviving rebuild/re-ingestion, and restoration into an empty isolated store, plus latency, model cost and operator steps. Compare each complete documented deployment and hold models constant where supported.
evidence_gaps: No reviewed comparison measures the entire requirement across the shortlisted native-client installations. The packet's Mac retrieval comparison used different capture amounts and embedders and did not run every shortlisted system.

WSL2 execution, isolated restore fidelity and RTX 4090 inference performance were not tested. The requirement permits CPU or service-backed operation; exact agentmemory macOS arm64 installation remains unverified.

ai-memory purge is logical: Git history and prior backups retain content. Hindsight transfer changes fact/entity identifiers, while complete hard-delete propagation remains unverified. agentmemory release and default-branch engine versions differ.

Published metrics use incompatible retrieval versus answer-accuracy protocols. Managed-platform results were not transferred to open-source implementations; misleading cross-project feature matrices were checked against each repository's own source.

Budget used: 30 GitHub API requests, including one failed HTTP 502 request; one web search; zero successful webpage fetches. README and documentation evidence was obtained from GitHub source and read through ctx_search.

The required ctx_fetch_and_index call was rejected with: 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Full webpage and paper inspection therefore remains incomplete; no permission workaround was attempted.
